statement.fr: Tian-Su est un membre actif de plusieurs organisations, où il a géré de nombreux événements. On l'a vu à la Dawson Esports Association, aux soirées de mahjong de Chinatown Youth (@jqc_cty), et à Art Bloc.
statement.en: Tian-Su is an active member of several organisations, where he has run many events. He has been with the Dawson Esports Association, Chinatown Youth's mahjong nights (@jqc_cty), and Art Bloc.
